ZWE.note: The story is about errors in a government AI traffic system, not a rule or body controlling harms from AI.

facts.fact: NewZimbabwe reports Harare's AI-powered Smart Traffic Management System, introduced by the Ministry of Home Affairs in June 2026, is in service and issuing traffic violations.
An MP said more than six million violations were recorded since June 2026, and the system reportedly detects over 40,000 violations a day in Harare.
